BlogArticle.title: BlogArticle
BlogArticle.description: A generated long-form blog article with Blogger-compatible HTML, SEO metadata, verified sources, and optional embedded JPEG images.

userId.description: Owner Firebase Auth UID matching the parent user document.

topicTitle.description: Original trending topic title selected or searched by the user.

actualWordCount.description: Computed word count of the generated plain text article.

plainTextContent.description: Clean plain text / Markdown article content ready for copy-paste.

bloggerHtmlContent.description: Responsive Blogger-compatible HTML template with {{HERO_IMAGE_SRC}} and {{INLINE_IMAGE_SRC}} placeholders.

heroImageAlt.description: Accessible ALT description for the hero article image.

heroImageCaption.description: Editorial caption for the hero article image.

heroImageBase64.description: Optional compressed JPEG base64 payload for the hero article image.

inlineImageAlt.description: Accessible ALT description for the inline section image.

inlineImageCaption.description: Editorial caption for the inline section image.

inlineImageBase64.description: Optional compressed JPEG base64 payload for the inline section image.

sources.description: Verified web grounding source citations (title | url).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when saved (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/articles/{articleId}.description: User-owned generated blog articles and Blogger HTML exports.
